name: Zetan
title: Levites in David's Service
summary: Zetan (also spelled Zetam) was a Levite of the Gershonite clan, son of Ladan (Libni). He served as one of the temple treasurers under King David, responsible for the treasures in the house of the Lord. He is mentioned in the genealogies of the Levitical families that were organized for temple service.

keyEvents.title: Appointed Among the Levites
keyEvents.description: Zetan is mentioned as a son of Ladan among the Gershonite Levites, who were organized for service in the house of the Lord during David's time.

keyEvents.title: Management of Temple Treasures
keyEvents.description: Zetan and his brothers were given responsibility for managing the treasures in the house of the Lord, an important task among the Levitical families.

keyEvents.title: Organization of Levitical Service
keyEvents.description: David organized the Levites by their families, and Zetan's family was assigned specific duties related to temple service.

keyEvents.title: Role of the Gershonite Clan
keyEvents.description: As part of the Gershonite clan, Zetan belonged to one of the three main branches of the tribe of Levi who were assigned important roles in worship.
